title: Shared pharmacy services and central fill
rule_summary: Massachusetts Board Policy 2021-02 permits shared pharmacy service models, including central fill, under defined safeguards. Participating pharmacies may be under common ownership or may operate under a written agreement that defines the services and each participant's responsibilities; common ownership is not the sole permissible relationship.
exam_relevance: Tests the contractual and accountability structure of central fill rather than treating it as an unregulated outsourcing arrangement.

authority.name: Shared Pharmacy Service Models Including Central Fill, Remote Processing, and Telepharmacy

common_confusions: Unrelated ownership does not by itself prohibit shared pharmacy services when the required written agreement and safeguards are present.
verification_notes: Current official Massachusetts authority verified during Pre-Batch3 T2 authoring on 2026-08-18; fresh independent legal and realism audit is still required before release.
